cableCar.slot: Continuous centre slot between the running rails (approx. 19 mm / 3/4 in wide) for the grip; slot rails flush with pavement; cable ~0.45 m below street
cableCar.operation: 7 a.m. - 11 p.m. daily; 9-20 min headways; fare $8 (Dec 2024 sign on car 26); spring-2025 pulley/sheave upgrades; grip bell rung at every crossing and stop

streetlight.style: Two families. (1) Historic ornamental pedestrian standards of the 1917-18 downtown retail-district ('Golden Triangle'/Union Square) type, photo-verified on Powell: dark green-black cast-iron fluted shaft on a stepped ornamental base, gilded (gold-leaf) acanthus collar and ornament, single elongated acorn/urn opal-glass lantern with cast metal cap and finial; pole ~4.5 m, lantern top ~5.2 m. Present along Powell (Market-Geary and along the square), and on the Stockton/Post/Geary frontages of the square (verify block-by-block). (2) SFPUC standard roadway poles: round black-painted steel poles (22-30 ft = 6.7-9.1 m mounting height), single arm with LED cobra-head or teardrop-pendant luminaire, 3000 K, at intersections and mid-block; OSM records 'straight_mast' lamps on Post (Stockton-Grant) at ~28-30 m spacing.

meters.style: SFMTA IPS single-space smart meters: grey/silver domed head (~0.30 m) on a 1.3 m grey steel post, credit-card + coin, some 'pay-by-plate' kiosks; blue/green rate decals
meters.where: Mason, Sutter, O'Farrell, Grant and side streets; essentially none on the four square frontages (Stockton no parking; Powell taxi/loading; Post/Geary loading/bus/garage). Colour-curb zones: white (passenger loading), yellow (commercial loading), red (no stopping) painted on curb faces.
meters.source: OSM parking:lane tags; SFMTA taxi-zone legislation nodes; general SFMTA meter program

hydrants.style: Two SF types: (a) domestic low-pressure hydrants - white barrel, coloured bonnet/caps; OSM tags the ones at Post/Stockton/Sutter/Powell as white with BLUE bonnets and white caps (5 tagged); (b) AWSS high-pressure hydrants - larger diameter barrel with a black-painted top in the downtown 'lower zone' (red = upper zone, blue = Twin Peaks). Positions (OSM, sidewalk pillars): 37.788397,-122.408534 (Powell/Post NW), 37.788137,-122.408275 (Powell, plaza side mid-block), 37.787571,-122.408169 (Powell/Geary NE), 37.788660,-122.406049 and 37.788533,-122.406255 (Post near Stockton, blue bonnet), 37.788627,-122.405391 (Post/Grant, blue), 37.789358,-122.407143 (Sutter/Stockton, blue bonnet), 37.789128,-122.408528 (Powell/Sutter, white;blue). Fire-alarm (Gamewell) call box on a pole at 37.788405,-122.408372 (Powell/Post).
hydrants.source: OSM emergency=fire_hydrant nodes (2021-2025); SFPUC AWSS zone colour convention

trash.style: SF Public Works green 'Renaissance' can (1993-): dark green powder-coated steel, ~1.2 m tall, ~0.6 m dia, domed lid with side openings, 'SF' recycling decals - still the standard on the boundary streets (OSM tags 'green metal' at Powell/Sutter and Geary/Mason). Replacement 'Slim Silhouette' (narrow rectangular, sensor-equipped, graffiti-resistant) rollout funded March 2025 ($15 M) - expect a mix by 2026. Inside the plaza the Union Square Alliance uses its own black/green litter bins beside each bench.
trash.positions: 39 waste baskets mapped in the core; on the square frontages: Powell plaza-side row at 37.787809/37.787909/37.788010,-122.40813, Post plaza-side 37.788193,-122.407651 and 37.788212,-122.407505, Geary/Stockton 37.787735,-122.407568, Stockton/Post 37.788585,-122.406642
trash.source: OSM amenity=waste_basket; SF Public Works press release 2022-12-22; SFist 2025-03-15 (Slim Silhouette relaunch)

other: Hearts in San Francisco sculptures: one ~1.8 m painted fibreglass heart on a plinth at each of the four plaza corners, rotated yearly by SF General Hospital Foundation. 2025-26: 'SOL' by Dev Heyrana at the Powell/Geary (SW) corner (installed 2025); 'Labyrinthine Heart' (Wendy Ackrell, 2023) at the Geary/Stockton (SE) corner 37.787729,-122.406876; 'Butterflight' (Naomi Duben) 37.787565,-122.408022; unnamed heart at the Powell/Post (NW) corner 37.788152,-122.408152 (OSM).

Benches: plaza-edge black metal benches with backrests in rows along the Powell side (37.78807-37.78774,-122.4077..-122.4079, 7 units) and Geary/Stockton side (37.78782-37.78794,-122.4070..-122.4074, 5 units); steel backless bench at Powell/O'Farrell; stone benches at Grant/Bush. 2025 Powell design adds gold-finished benches and cable-car 'leaning rails'.

Bike racks: SFMTA black inverted-U racks (2 bikes each): Powell/Post NW 10 stands (37.788475,-122.408563), Powell plaza side (37.787789,-122.408433), Post/Stockton 8 stands (37.788631,-122.406926), Sutter/Stockton (37.789405/37.789410,-122.4075), plus 25 others in the core (OSM list).
Bollards: 4 black steel bollards in a line at 37.787813-37.787888,-122.408216..-122.408231 (Powell sidewalk at the plaza's SW corner); swing gate + bollards at the Maiden Lane/Stockton entrance.

Utility/street cabinets: green traffic-signal controller cabinets (~1.4 x 0.6 x 0.4 m) at each signalised corner (e.g. 37.788227,-122.408236 Powell/Post; 37.787592,-122.408171 Powell/Geary); USPS relay boxes (olive green) at 37.788479,-122.406540, 37.788557,-122.405964, 37.787725,-122.404909; USPS blue collection boxes at 17 corners (e.g. 37.788224,-122.408585 Powell/Post, 37.787288,-122.408489 Powell/Geary, 37.788476,-122.406550 Post/Stockton).

Newspaper racks: SF 'pedmount' multi-publication racks survive only sporadically (OSM: 37.788788,-122.405118 Post/Grant, 37.789356,-122.407152 Sutter/Stockton, 37.788200,-122.409791 and 37.787992,-122.410315 Post/Mason); none on the square frontages.

Taxi zones (SFMTA legislation via OSM): 395 Powell west side 13-136 ft S of Post; 251 Geary south side 138-222 ft E of Powell; 450 Powell east side 95-135 ft S of Sutter; 478 Sutter north side 97-140 ft E of Powell; 395 Sutter 20-160 ft E of Stockton; 342 Grant east side 10-32 ft S of Bush.

Union Square Alliance: 'Ambassador' staff and wayfinding map pylons at the plaza corners; visitor information desk inside Macy's (level -1, 37.786764,-122.407294); SF Arts Commission info board 37.787739,-122.407026. Exact pylon positions UNRESOLVED.
Drinking fountain (bubbler) 37.787902,-122.406996; public toilets 37.787686,-122.407442 (plaza, Geary side); analog 4-face street clock on a pole at Grant/O'Farrell 37.786721,-122.404865.
Rooftop billboards (Outfront/Clear Channel) on the Stockton/Post corner buildings (37.7882-37.7887,-122.4066) and Powell/Geary (37.787217,-122.408382; 37.787284,-122.407997) - visible from the plaza.

Flagpoles: hotel flag rows (e.g. Beacon Grand / 450 Powell at 37.789213,-122.408033: ASEAN + Philippines flags; US flag on 300 Post roof 37.788702,-122.406208). Westin St. Francis flags over its Powell marquee.
Surveillance cameras: 31 wall/ceiling-mounted cameras mapped on Post/Mason/Geary storefronts (OSM) - minor.

Holiday season (mid-Nov - early Jan): Macy's 25 m Christmas tree at the plaza centre-east, Safeway Holiday Ice Rink on the plaza's west lawn, Powell trees lit, menorah; decorated cable cars (garlands, lights) as in the Dec 2024 photo; Union Square Alliance 'Winter Walk' closes Stockton (Geary-Ellis? verify) some years - UNRESOLVED for 2026.

uncertainties: Curb-to-curb and sidewalk widths are derived, not surveyed (+/-1 m). Powell Geary-Post east-side geometry (island + curb lane) is inferred from OSM offsets.
Red 'MUNI ONLY' cable-car lanes north of Geary verified in Oct 2017 photography only; assumed retained in 2026.
Post St curbside bus lane exists only as an OSM tag; hours/red-paint status unverified.
Signal pole style and 60 s cycle are inferred from photography and SFMTA practice; Powell Safety Project 2025-26 may have replaced poles at Ellis/O'Farrell/Geary/Post.
Streetlight naming ('Golden Triangle') unverified; design is photo-verified.
Union Square Garage pedestrian kiosk positions and ramp opening widths are estimates.
Stockton & Geary / Post & Powell bus stop shelter status unknown.
Powell Street Improvement Project (Market-Geary) construction 'winter 2026 - winter 2027': the O'Farrell-Geary block may be a construction zone on 2026-09-01.
